decisions: Version is 8.1.1 / 21. UpgradeCleanupManager runs local cleanup before UI and automatic sync from YomiraApp.onCreate. The persisted last_seen_version advances only after successful cleanup; interrupted cleanup retries safely.

Pre-21 builds had no version marker. For a missing marker, Android PackageInfo.lastUpdateTime > firstInstallTime identifies an upgrade; a genuinely fresh installation only records version 21 without clearing data or showing the notice.

Use public manifest/installer/repository APIs. Remove every manifest and corresponding DEX cache, regenerate the empty manifest index, persist an explicit empty repository list, clear onboarding repository/suggested-package references, and clear bundledRepositoriesSeeded. No ExtensionManager internals were changed.

repositoriesUserManaged prevents SettingsViewModel from re-seeding cleared bundled URLs. A persisted sources_cleared flag disables NativeSourceRepository's implicit installed MangaDex entry after migration; fresh-install behavior remains unchanged on this branch.

DriveExtensionStore revokes local synced extension records with newer uninstall tombstones and empty repository/manifest references while preserving their custom configuration preferences, so automatic sync does not resurrect removed sources.

Library, vault, history, achievements and other UI preferences are outside the cleanup capability boundary. Onboarding consent, language, excluded tags, favorites and unrelated settings remain intact.
The EN/TR notice is a resource-localized dialog in MainActivity. Its pending state survives recreation/restart until acknowledgment, then remains dismissed.

F3 audit found that detail ensureSource skipped matching for cached chapters and home resume / Updates Hub navigated directly to reader. Detail now reranks cached series, and the shared reader route resolves through ReadingSourceResolver before composing ReaderScreen. Requested chapter numbers map to selected-source IDs; missing matches or missing requested chapter numbers fail closed rather than reading stale sources or jumping to another chapter.

SmartSourceMatcher implementation differed from its README: ranking was count then date only. It now uses bounded exact-language 1000, relative completeness 500, recency 200, verified healthy 300 and speed 100 weights, then count/date tie-breakers. Only trusted installed sources are queried. Existing tests that asserted the previous contrary ranking were updated to the contract.

ReadingSourceResolverTest exercises real matcher-to-DAO activation, cached and replaced chapter-ID cases, most-complete/fresh same-language selection, absent chapters, and removed installations. MainActivity's one reader-route gate covers home resume, detail read/continue and Updates Hub; navigation wiring was source-inspected, not device-tested.

mergeNotes: Commit on v811-upgrade-migration only; no push. Requested commit message: feat(migration): purge extensions on upgrade to 8.1.1 + version bump (v811-F2/F3).
Forbidden OnboardingScreen.kt, onboarding/OnboardingViewModel.kt and AndroidManifest.xml were not edited. No .orchestrator content other than this handoff was touched.
MainActivity.kt shared-file hunks: inject/show the upgrade notice and add the reader-route resolution gate. Preserve other agents' onboarding and extensions navigation/UI changes around these hunks.
YomiraViewModel.kt shared-file hunks: always match from ensureSource, plus resolveReadingChapter. YomiraApp.kt adds startup cleanup before automaticSync.start; preserve this ordering.

OnboardingModule.kt and NativeSourceRepository.kt add a migration-aware native-source guard. If another agent removes built-in source wiring entirely, retain their stronger removal rather than restoring the wrapper; keep migration cleanup and marker wiring.

SettingsViewModel.kt only adds the repositoriesUserManaged no-reseed guard. SettingsModels.kt and DataStoreSettingsStore.kt add/persist that flag. If F1 removes all automatic seeding, keep its stronger policy while retaining the cleared legacy seed flag.
Matcher ranking changes intentionally supersede the old count-only/language-agnostic ranking tests; README weights were the requested contract. Merge domain matcher and its tests together.
